title: The Distant Colony Again
author: Gideon Voss
blurb: Rosalind Pemberton, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
